rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sheet of paper tissue, including a facial tissue or handkerchief tissue.

example.english: I grabbed a tissue to wipe off my sweat.
example.jyutping: ngo5 lo2 zoeng1 zi2 gan1 mut3 haa5 hon6

rows.note: Use this technical noun for body tissue made up of cells with a shared function.

example.english: This type of tissue repairs damaged skin.
example.traditional: 呢種組織負責修補受損嘅皮膚。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 zou2 zik1 fu6 zaak3 sau1 bou2 sau6 syun2 ge3 pei4 fu1

rows.note: Use this for the connected web or network sense, rather than for physical tissue or paper tissue.

example.traditional: 社會網絡將大家連埋一齊。
example.jyutping: se5 wui6 mong5 lok3 zoeng1 daai6 gaa1 lin4 maai4 jat1 cai4

rows.note: Use this for thin, gauzelike fabric, not for a paper tissue.

example.english: This dress is made of gauzy tissue and is very light.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 jung6 saa1 zou6 hou2 hing1 san1
